question: What meaningful information does the GRU model capture, which traditional ML models do not?

extractive_spans: the context and sequential nature of the text
evidence: Our architecture was designed to show that using a model that captures better information about the context and sequential nature of the text can outperform lexicon-based methods commonly used in the literature. As mentioned in the Introduction, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) have been shown to perform well for the verity of tasks in NLP, especially classification tasks. And as our goal was to capture more information about the context and sequential nature of the text, we decided to use a model based on bidirectional RNN, specifically a bidirectional GRU network to analyze the tweets.

title: Emotion Detection in Text: Focusing on Latent Representation
answer_short: The GRU model captures the sequential nature and context of text, which traditional ML models ignore.
answer_rationale: The GRU model is specifically designed to capture the sequential nature and context of text, which traditional ML models like bag-of-words fail to do. This is highlighted in the abstract and related work sections, where the authors argue that traditional models ignore the sequential nature of text and context, leading to insufficient performance in emotion detection. The GRU model, by contrast, is shown to significantly improve performance by capturing these elements.
